name: neocode
description: Matrix-style ambience for Claude Code: code decays into upward-streaming digital rain as it scrolls toward the top of the screen. Display-only: scrolling or selecting clears it until you pause; /neocode toggles it.

enabled.title: Rain on at start
enabled.description: Whether the effect starts on. /neocode toggles it and remembers your choice.

reach.title: Reach
reach.description: How far down the screen the decay reaches: gentle, balanced or deep.

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: katakana: authentic Matrix glyphs. letters: ASCII only, for fonts without half-width katakana.

resumeDelay.title: Resume after (seconds)
resumeDelay.description: Scrolling or selecting text clears the rain at once; it returns after this many seconds without either. 1 to 60.

fps.title: Frames per second
fps.description: Animation rate, 5 to 30. Lower it if your terminal struggles.
